caption: The image depicts a rectangular, wooden-cased wall clock with a rich, reddish-brown finish and architectural details such as columns on the sides and a corniced top. The clock face is circular, featuring Roman numerals in black on a white background and black hour and minute hands positioned at approximately 10:09. Surrounding the clock face, there is a decorative border with a light-colored floral pattern. Below the clock face, there are two rectangular panels. The upper panel shows an engraved, green-tinted scene of a neoclassical building set behind trees, with the words "Union Park" inscribed in the center at the bottom. The lower panel contains a colored illustration, mainly in shades of green, yellow, and brown, depicting trees, a horse-drawn carriage, and groups of people in front of buildings under a sky transitioning from yellow to dark blue. The structure of the case frames all three sections, with the wood grain clearly rendered throughout the drawing.
title: Mantel Clock
